detected_issues.description: Evaluation & Management code 99214 billed on the same date as Knee MRI 73721 without required Modifier 25. Will trigger commercial/Medicare bundling denial CO-97.
detected_issues.policy_reference: CMS Claims Processing Manual Ch. 12 §30.6.6 & NCCI Policy Manual Ch. 1

detected_issues.description: Knee MRI procedure 73721 operates on paired anatomical extremity but lacks mandated laterality modifier (-RT). Diagnosis M23.22 explicitly specifies Right Knee.
detected_issues.policy_reference: Medicare Claims Processing Manual Ch. 23 & Payer Imaging Matrix

recommended_fixes.rationale: Append Modifier 25 to 99214 (yielding 99214-25). Documentation establishes distinct 30-minute cognitive E/M for hypertension.
Append -RT modifier to CPT 73721 (yielding 73721-RT) matching documented right knee meniscal tear.

detected_issues.description: Brain MRI (CPT 70551) fails LCD-BRAIN-MRI medical necessity criteria. Linked diagnosis G44.209 (uncomplicated tension headache) without focal neurological deficits, seizure, or trauma is a non-covered indication.
detected_issues.policy_reference: CMS LCD-BRAIN-MRI & Title XVIII Social Security Act §1862(a)(1)(A)

recommended_fixes.rationale: Hold claim pre-submission. Remove CPT 70551 or request provider clinical addendum documenting qualifying neurological red flags (e.g. papilledema, focal weakness).

recommended_fixes.rationale: Remove CPT 36415 from claim or bundle fee into preventive service. Routine venipuncture during annual exam is not separately reimbursable without Modifier 59.
